```{r}
# List of Games to grab
appids <- c(730, 570, 440) #(CS2, Dota 2, Team Fortress 2)

# Finds the current number of players in the games listed in appids
get_player_count <- function(appid) {
  r <- GET(
    "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers/v1/",
    query = list(appid = appid)
  )
  stop_for_status(r)
  fromJSON(content(r, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))$response$player_count
}

counts <- tibble(appid = appids) |>
  mutate(players = sapply(appid, function(id) {
    Sys.sleep(1)
    get_player_count(id)
  }))

count



get_store_details <- function(appid, currency = "us", language = "english") {
    url <- "https://store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails"
    resp <- GET(
      url, 
      query = list(
      appids = appid, 
      cc = currency,
      l = language)
    )
    stop_for_status(resp)
    data <- fromJSON(content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
    data
}
cod <- get_store_details(4435490)
cod

as.character(cod$`4435490`$data$name)

ultrakill <- get_store_details("1229490")
ultrakill
```

```{r}
game_data <- tibble(name = character(),
                    app_id = character(),
                    description = character(),
                    developers = character(),
                    publishers = character(),
                    price_usd = numeric(),
                    release = as.Date(character()),
                    esrb_rating = character()
                    )

app_vec = c("4435490", "960090", "632360", "1229490", "413150", "620", "2679460") # for some reason, only specific games from this list appear in the final game_data
# the first, third, fifth, and seventh games appear, which makes me wonder if the for loop is cycling through games too fast, and if a buffer should be added.

#UPDATE: It wasn't the buffer - tested with Sys.sleep and the same games are appearing

for (temp_app_id in app_vec) {
    temp_store_data = get_store_details(temp_app_id)
    game_data <- add_row(game_data,
            name = temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$name,
            app_id = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$steam_appid),
            description = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$short_description),
            developers = toString(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$developers),
            publishers = toString(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$publishers),
            price_usd = parse_number(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$price_overview$final_formatted),
            release = mdy(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$release_date$date),
            esrb_rating = as.character(temp_store_data[[as.character(temp_app_id)]]$data$ratings$esrb$rating)
           )
}
game_data
```
